newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures market were mixed in quiet after-hours trade on Tuesday, as selling orders from local investors pushed down distant months, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.3 yen per kg lower to 0.4 yen higher than the day's close. The benchmark March contract was up 0.3 yen at 134.4 yen. Daily volume was 4,817 lots.

The market maintained a bearish mood, in line with the Tokyo market, because of the ample rubber stocks in Japan, the traders said. "The stocks are likely to be a major bearish factor for a while. We're watching for when the stocks will hit the peak," a brokerage house trader said.
